en.stack: Node.js, Python, FastAPI, .NET Core, GraphQL, Docker, Kubernetes
en.title: From a PHP monolith to microservices
en.summary: As tech lead, I led the move of Trocafone's legacy PHP monolith to microservices behind a GraphQL gateway.
en.context: Trocafone's systems ran on a legacy PHP monolith that had to scale and become easier to maintain.
en.role: Tech lead: I led the migration.
en.built: Services in Node.js, Python (FastAPI) and .NET Core took over the monolith's parts. A GraphQL gateway gave the clients unified access to the APIs, and the services ran in Docker containers orchestrated by Kubernetes.
en.result: Better performance and developer experience, with more fault tolerance and scalability.
